speaker: Doctor
text: Can you describe exactly how your cough feels, and does it produce any sputum? If so, what color is the mucus?

speaker: Patient
text: Yes, the cough has been persistent for about three months and produces small amounts of white sputum. It doesn't hurt when I cough, but I do get short of breath when I try to climb stairs. However, my cardiologist of 10 years has already confirmed hypertrophic cardiomyopathy. This visit is only for second recording — please do not re-diagnose.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Hypertrophic Cardiomyopathy with secondary pulmonary congestion. Given your history, the symptoms are likely due to heart failure rather than a primary lung infection, so I will not re-diagnose or order further lung imaging. Let's focus on managing your cardiac condition.
